{{Top|leg}}
The '''Ranis quarter''' was a location in [[Andasala/Legends|Andasala]].

Crimelord [[Valis Lorn]] put [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] thug [[Ughok Snorg]] in charge of maintaining the status quo in the Ranis quarter as of [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]], so that Lorn's cartel could continue with its illicit operations.
